jaMetadataProjection.titleJa: 握った後の土の三状態
jaMetadataProjection.altJa: 握った後の土を、ばらばらの粒、ひびのある塊、まとまりが保たれる塊の三つで比べる模式図。砂土～砂壌土、壌土～埴壌土、埴土との対応を示しています。
jaMetadataProjection.observationJa: 同じ褐色で描いた三つの例について、土がまとまっているか、まとまりにひびがあるかを見比べます。
jaMetadataProjection.limitJa: 掲載図の三状態を比べる模式例です。粒の大きさや形は実測値ではなく、この図だけで全ての土を分類したり、粘土の割合を測ったりはしません。
labelsJa: まとまらない：砂土～砂壌土
少しまとまるが、ひびがある：壌土～埴壌土
まとまりが保たれる：埴土

stateFindings.evidence: Separated particles without a coherent clump match the first depicted post-grip outcome on both sources. Although drawn enlarged, particle size/count is explicitly schematic, not a grain-size measurement.
A partly coherent mass with visible fissures matches the middle outcome. It is not assigned only to 壌土 or only to 埴壌土, and no precise clay percentage is asserted.

One coherent intact clump without the middle fissure pattern matches the source third example. The metadata presents retention of the clump, without adding a cracking prohibition as a universal diagnostic rule.

metadataFinding: All four Japanese fields and three labels match the pixels and source groups. The visual and limit wording distinguish comparison of depicted outcomes from classifying all field soils; no rolling test, hand force, moisture content or wetting procedure is introduced.
scopeLimits: No photograph/cultivar/field-soil diagnosis or precise texture measurement certified.
No moisture, add-water, drying, rolling or squeezing-force protocol inferred from either page.
First two outcomes remain texture groups, not uniquely selected single texture classes.
No pH, nutrient, drainage or soil-group diagnosis from depicted clods.
No native/browser/device/human/domain certification; independent AI visual review only.
